# SameWindow

> SameWindow is an AI agent flight recorder for developers. It records agent executions so developers can inspect tool calls, replay failures, compare successful and failed runs, and identify the first meaningful divergence.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://samewindow.com/)
- [Pricing](https://samewindow.com/pricing)
- [Documentation](https://samewindow.com/docs)
- [Engineering Blog](https://samewindow.com/blog)
- [Security](https://samewindow.com/security)

## Core capabilities

- AI agent execution tracing
- Tool-call inspection
- Run timelines
- Failed-run replay
- Successful vs failed run comparison
- First divergence detection
- Token and estimated cost tracking
- AI-assisted failure analysis
- Redaction controls

## API

The public API surface currently includes health checks, trace ingestion, failure analysis, and run comparison. Persistent trace storage is being connected to the production database layer.
